Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.contentType())
debugPrint(result.html())
debugPrint(result.metadata().title() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().description() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().canonicalUrl() as Any)
debugPrint(result.links().count)
debugPrint(result.links()[0].linkType())
debugPrint(result.images().count)
debugPrint(result.metadata().ogTitle() as Any)
```
